verdict.rationale: Fathom's own documented features run in the background after meetings: CRM field sync updates records automatically, key topics are monitored automatically, and registered webhooks push new meeting content to a URL without manual action. However, there is no evidence of a general user-configurable automation builder, recurring schedules, or agentic multi-step workflows, so this is limited to fixed post-meeting triggers. Missing for 10: user-defined automation/workflow builder, recurring or scheduled runs, autonomous agent actions beyond CRM sync and alerts, independent hands-on corroboration.
